status: Partial support controller, not a completed enemy port or dedicated encounter.

source_contract.unlit: Bomb Grimace keeps a throwable bomb available. The pickup cannot add ordinary inventory bombs.
source_contract.take: The bomb can be picked up and thrown; its fuse starts after pickup, not on initial floor supply.
source_contract.replenish: A few seconds after Isaac takes the bomb, supplier creates another. Exact delay and global-versus-per-producer stock ownership remain unmeasured.
source_contract.exceptional_death: Bomb Grimace emits ten Throwable Bombs on documented instant-death destruction. Generic execution is only a test hook; named item producers remain necessary.

deathward_adaptations.parameters: External replenish 2.5 s, fuse 3 s, radius 4.5 units, damage 100, holder damage 25, throw range 12, flight 0.7 s, pickup radius 0.75. Ten exceptional-death drops are sourced; other values are local tuning, not measured native constants. Float clocks may cross a configured boundary one fixed tick late. Invulnerable display HP 64 retains the local 3.2 conversion of source baseHP 20.
deathward_adaptations.ownership: Each producer tracks its own single normal unlit pickup. Taking schedules replenishment independently of existing carried/thrown ordnance. Other producers and death drops do not suppress it. This ownership choice is not verified against native Isaac.
deathward_adaptations.controls: Actual player contact takes a pickup. Mouse picking walks to stock; attack/arrow aim throws held ordnance; B places or throws according to existing mode. HUD throw accepts zero inventory. Holding takes precedence over ordinary gun/dynamite use. At most one carried bomb.
deathward_adaptations.physics: Shared swept ballistic terrain/cover collision; existing gravity 18 units/s squared. Throwing or placing never resets fuse. Held detonation can hurt player and uses player-origin damage without the hostile 1.25 multiplier. Its explosion has explicit SuppliedBomb demolition provenance, opening existing cache/cracked rock/ore routes without inventory spend. Braid is not copied without source evidence.
deathward_adaptations.persistence: Unlit pickups do not age. Floor-wide vector retains ground stock; thrown bombs pause outside their active room. Carried bombs continue with player through rooms and real floor transitions, retaining fuse and rule snapshot; former supplier link clears on next floor. Ground ordnance stays behind. These are declared local transition policies.
deathward_adaptations.capacity: 128 supplied bombs per floor. At most 32 pending exceptional drops per producer. Placement tries up to 160 deterministic radial candidates, checks current-room bounds, cover, entrance/cache reservations, path to player, and pickup spacing. Failed placement retries after 0.25 s. Pending death drops are retained rather than silently lost.
deathward_adaptations.completion: Non-hostile support never seals doors or earns normal kill/loot credit. Ordinary combat clear does not stop production. Existing statue execution/re-entry lifecycle is reused; stock persists and re-entry does not replay death burst. No ordinary or optional hazard-pool entry is enabled.
deathward_adaptations.visuals: Original procedural stone head with bomb emblem and gold rim; low-poly bomb, fuse spark, unlit pickup ring and lit blast/fuse rings. Carried visual is raised 0.8 units clear of hat without changing explosion origin. All-angle readability is not yet accepted.

unresolved: Exact native supply ownership, fuse/replenishment/startup timings, throwable speed/range/collision and pickup knockback require measurement.
Tuff Twins, The Shell and Mother's Shadow dedicated encounter/escape producers remain unimplemented; no natural reachability acceptance.
Named instant-kill items, item-hit/reroll exceptions and per-bomb item inheritance are not established by generic execution hooks.
Mandatory encounter recovery after all bombs are wasted or supplier destroyed needs explicit encounter design/testing.
Save/reload of transient supplied-bomb state follows current expedition reconstruction rather than serializing mid-fuse ordnance; source-exact re-entry/floor behavior remains unverified.
All-camera readability, mixed-build/human balance and controlled current-roster native/WASM performance remain open.

visual_review.observed: Original scene treatment retained. Unlit stock has a pickup ring, held bomb/fuse is visibly above the hat after display offset correction, thrown bomb has a blast ring, and exceptional-death stock forms distinct pickups around the supplier.
visual_review.limits: Isolated camera/zoom only. Crowded boss arenas, occlusion and all-angle readability not accepted. Screenshot FPS is not controlled performance evidence.
